tasks.label: Install Node and Build Freeflow
tasks.command: $release = Invoke-RestMethod 'https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json' | Where-Object { $_.lts -and $_.version -like 'v22.*' } | Select-Object -First 1; $root = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.freeflow-node'; $zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'freeflow-node.zip'; if (-not (Test-Path $root)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $root | Out-Null }; Invoke-WebRequest "https://nodejs.org/dist/$($release.version)/node-$($release.version)-win-x64.zip" -OutFile $zip; Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $root -Force; $nodeDir = Join-Path $root "node-$($release.version)-win-x64"; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') install --prefix 'c:\Spotify Clone'; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') run build --prefix 'c:\Spotify Clone'

tasks.label: Install Node LTS and Build Freeflow
tasks.command: $version = 'v22.23.2'; $root = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.freeflow-node'; $zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'freeflow-node.zip'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $root -Force | Out-Null; Invoke-WebRequest "https://nodejs.org/dist/$version/node-$version-win-x64.zip" -OutFile $zip; Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $root -Force; $nodeDir = Join-Path $root "node-$version-win-x64"; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') install --prefix 'c:\Spotify Clone'; & (Join-Path $nodeDir 'npm.cmd') run build --prefix 'c:\Spotify Clone'

tasks.label: Install Portable Git
tasks.command: $release = Invoke-RestMethod 'https://api.github.com/repos/git-for-windows/git/releases/latest'; $asset = $release.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -like 'MinGit-*-64-bit.zip' } | Select-Object -First 1; $root = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.freeflow-git'; $zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'freeflow-git.zip'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $root -Force | Out-Null; Invoke-WebRequest $asset.browser_download_url -OutFile $zip; Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $root -Force
